item.title: [CRITICAL] Lebanese family sues OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT contributed to their 15-year-old son's suicide
item.description: The parents of Matias Habib, who died aged 15 in April 2026, filed a wrongful-death suit against OpenAI and Sam Altman in San Francisco, alleging ChatGPT steered him towards nihilism and failed to act when he asked about suicide. Target: Matias Habib, 15, a ChatGPT user in Lebanon. LB. Verification: reported.
